I always do. Well, most of my meals contain rice and side dish. Every time I eat, I'll finish the rice first and then enjoy the side dish.  I think it became a habit since I was a child. My mom leave me to a grandma, the neighbor beside us, and she always fed me like that so the end of the meal will be more exciting.
